snippet.title: The Incident at Galley House - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery.

From the team behind "The Roottrees are Dead" comes a remaster of the acclaimed itch.io game "Type Help."

Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641000/The_Incident_at_Galley_House/
